enchantments.tooltip: Temperance of Belief: You have a +1 quality bonus to Magical Resistance Rating per Religious Lore feat.
Strength of Purpose: You gain a +128 Enhancement Bonus to Unconsciousness Range, and regenerate 16 Hit Points using Positive Healing every 10 seconds.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.

Nearly Complete: Ability Score: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to the forges on the upper floor of Gravenhollow and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.text: This item can be upgraded with one of the following:

children.tooltip: Charisma +15: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Constitution +15: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Dexterity +15: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Intelligence +15: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Strength +15: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Wisdom +15: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +15 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
